title: Concrete Pump Hopper, Grille and Agitator — Catalogue Cells, Daily Inspect
seoTitle: Concrete Pump Hopper Grille Agitator | Pinjin Xingtai
description: ACPA: keep the hopper grate in place; it stops oversize stone reaching the valve. Electric 40 lists hopper 0.4 m³. Pinjin does not print agitator RPM or a factory grate-bar spacing table. Inspect daily; do not run with the grate flipped up. Match the listed hopper cell, then inquire.

answerBlock.what: ACPA: the hopper grate (grille) must stay in place during charging; it is the last screen before the valve. Oversize stone that bypasses the grate is a classic blockage. Electric 40 prints hopper 0.4 m³. Integrated mixer pump is a mixer-plus-pump row (45 kW + 14 kW), not a substitute for a grate. Pinjin does not print agitator RPM, grate-bar millimetres or a factory cooling-water flow. Daily inspect grate, hopper walls and agitator as on the maintenance checklist. Never put hands in a turning agitator.
answerBlock.who: Operators and buyers who need the printed hopper cell and the ACPA grate rule, not an unpublished RPM or bar-spacing drawing.
factors: Keep the grate down while charging
Electric 40 hopper 0.4 m³ is a catalogue cell, not a pour-size guarantee
No published agitator RPM or grate-bar table
Blockage after a flipped grate is operator cause, not a pump defect we will relabel

faqs.question: Can I charge Electric 40 with the hopper grate flipped up to go faster?
faqs.answer: No. ACPA: the grate stays in place. It stops oversize aggregate and tools from reaching the S-valve. A flipped grate is a blockage and injury cause. Hopper 0.4 m³ is a volume cell, not a reason to bypass the screen.

faqs.question: What agitator RPM does Pinjin list?
faqs.answer: None. Product tables print hopper m³ where it exists (Electric 40: 0.4 m³). RPM, paddle count and grate-bar spacing are not catalogue cells. Photograph the hopper if you need a comment from Xingtai — unpublished RPM is not promised.

faqs.question: Does cooling water on the hopper appear in the catalogue?
faqs.answer: No cooling-water flow or jacket SKU is printed on the public product pages. Do not copy a marketplace ‘water-cooled hopper’ claim as a Pinjin spec. Inquire with the model slug if you saw a jacket on a photo — photos are not a flow table.
